senses.sense_definition: Вынудить кого-либо или что-либо войти в ограниченное пространство.

examples.text: Задача игрока — как можно меньшим количеством ударов <w>загнать</w> мячик в лунку.

target_lang_translations.en: The player's goal is to <w>drive</w> the ball into the hole in as few strokes as possible.
We managed to <w>drive</w> the squirrel up the tree.

target_lang_definitions.en: To force someone or something to enter a confined space.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To force or herd someone or something into a specific area.
To move a group of animals or people into a specific place.
To force someone into a position where they cannot escape.

senses.sense_definition: Управляя транспортным средством, переместить его в некое ограниченное пространство.

examples.text: Можно договориться с хозяином: машину <w>загнать</w> в бокс, а другую взять напрокат.

target_lang_translations.en: You can make an arrangement with the owner: <w>drive</w> the car into the garage and rent another one.

examples.text: Водитель смог <w>загнать</w> грузовик в узкий гараж.

target_lang_translations.en: The driver was able to <w>drive</w> the truck into the narrow garage.

target_lang_definitions.en: To move a vehicle into a confined space, such as a garage or parking spot.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To steer a vehicle into a specific location.
To bring a vehicle to a stop and leave it in a specific place.

senses.sense_definition: Вбить, забить с силой или глубоко вонзить какой-либо предмет.

examples.text: Здесь они плотно закрыли дверь, стараясь <w>загнать</w> гвозди на их прежние места.

target_lang_translations.en: They closed the door tightly here, trying to <w>drive</w> the nails back into their original places.

examples.text: Мастеру пришлось <w>загнать</w> клин в щель, чтобы выровнять пол.

target_lang_translations.en: The craftsman had to <w>drive</w> a wedge into the gap to level the floor.

target_lang_definitions.en: To drive or hammer an object into something with force or depth.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To drive a nail or similar object into a surface using a tool.
To force an object into a position with great pressure or impact.
To force an object into a tight space to secure or separate it.

senses.sense_definition: Замучить или изнурить кого-либо чрезмерной работой или быстрой ездой.

examples.text: Сама дорога не позволяла ехать скорее, если не имелось в виду совершенно <w>загнать</w> несчастных лошадей.

target_lang_translations.en: The road itself didn't allow for faster travel, unless one intended to completely <w>exhaust</w> the poor horses.

examples.text: Нельзя так работать, можно <w>загнать</w> себя до болезни.

target_lang_translations.en: You shouldn't work like that; you could <w>work</w> yourself until you get sick.

target_lang_definitions.en: To exhaust or wear someone out through excessive work or intense physical activity.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To cause someone to become extremely exhausted through overwork.
To exhaust someone by making them do too much.
To make someone feel very tired or depleted.

senses.sense_definition: Продать или сбыть что-либо, часто по высокой цене.

examples.text: Если икона старая, её можно <w>загнать</w> за крутые бабки.

target_lang_translations.en: If the icon is old, you can <w>sell</w> it for a lot of money.
He decided to <w>sell</w> his old phone for a higher price.

target_lang_definitions.en: To sell or dispose of something, often quickly or for a high price (colloquial).

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To exchange an item for money.
To sell something, often informally or aggressively (UK slang).
To get rid of something by selling it, often something unwanted.
